articles.title: Robinhood wins UK crypto registration before new regulatory regime kicks off
articles.snippet: Robinhood’s U.K. arm was added to the FCA's list of registered cryptoasset companies as of July 31.

articles.title: The reverse bridge: Crypto meets Wall Street using perps
articles.snippet: Crypto exchanges built perpetual futures for digital assets. Now they are using them to offer 24/7 exposure to stocks, commodities and indexes.

articles.title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
articles.snippet: State officials reported that Minnesota residents, and largely senior citizens, had lost about $1 million from scams tied to crypto kiosks from 2023 to 2025.

articles.title: Tether Reports $1.5B Q2 Profit as USDT Supply Grows, Gold Holdings Rise
articles.snippet: The latest attestation offers a snapshot of the assets backing the world's largest stablecoin, including U.S. Treasuries, repo agreements, and more than 146 metric tons of gold.
